blocking_findings.detail: All 141 immutable origin keys changed under reused candidate family/revision IDs. All 22 attachment numeric IDs now denote different member sets; the same 22 groups were permuted to different IDs.
All 40 candidate packets retain their v33 packet IDs while all 40 evidence-bundle hashes changed. Packet IDs are derived only from revision ID, not revision plus evidence hash plus schema version.
Component IDs hash type, members, projections, and release but omit the build rule version required by P3_IDENTITY_KEY_SPEC_v7.csv.
All 141 candidate revisions are inserted with placeholder evidence hashes; only the 40 packet-selected revisions are updated, leaving 101 placeholder hashes.
P3CAND-000009 treats the one proposition-only edge internal to a strict component as UNRULED, carries no projection, and creates no required closure obligation.
Three new SQL child tables are absent from the 75-table schema dictionary and connected JSON schema surface; their semantic fields are not exported or included in packet hashes.
REDIRECT_OTHER_DOMAIN is stored as DIRECT_COLLISION, increments hard_collision_count, enters hard_collisions, and causes COLLISION_BEARING_CANDIDATE despite hard_blocker=false.
The production selector uses five broad queries, while summary artifacts claim eleven strata. Ranking columns are populated from unrelated quantities.
No delivered production code generates the pilot eligibility, selection, substitution, topology, object-count, fixture-summary, or convergence reports consumed by the verifier.

Positive duplicate-key exceptions are still treated as PASS_ALREADY_COMMITTED; incomplete promotion fails at missing variant assignment; stale-hash mutation changes top-level hashes only; required new mutations are absent.
336 UNRULED rows and only 345 total pair obligations conceal one UNRULED direct-authority row without an obligation. Selected packet validation does not cover all 141 candidates.
WORKTREE_STATE.json and EXACT_CONTINUATION.md remain at pre-execution IN_PROGRESS state, and no PostgreSQL teardown proof is delivered in section 56.
Schema, identity rules, candidate origins, and packets continue to use the inherited R31 release ID rather than an append-only successor release and migration record.
